messages:
elaine: kicking off a strawman for Q2 Hosted API roadmap — want to capture scope bets and customer asks for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank. short thread to align on launch criteria and priority.

devon: quick question — do we treat embeddings throughput as a product slice or infra optimization? some customers want 5k qps.

sarah: embeddings is a combo: model/path optim + infra. we need a concrete eval set for accuracy vs quantization tradeoffs.

mike: infra note — current dedicated pool is already ~85% booked in eu-west. supporting 5k qps for hosted might require reserved capacity or burst buckets.

linda: CS: ACME + Helix asked for guaranteed embeddings throughput and rerank SLA next quarter. they'd pay for reserved, but need clear launch promise.

elaine: proposed slices (strawman):
- slice A: embeddings throughput & cost (customer configs + burst)
- slice B: streaming & function-calling latency improvements for chat/completions
- slice C: rerank quality guardrails + canary tooling

devon: suggest launch criteria snippet:
```
launch_criteria = [
  "p99 latency <= 300ms for streaming baseline",
  "embeddings throughput >= customer_target under SLA (95th percentile)",
  "rerank quality no regression on golden set (<1% delta)",
  "rollback/auto-fallback in place"
]
```

sarah: add monitoring/validation items:
- automatic eval runs on golden set post-deploy
- alert if embedding similarity drift > threshold

mike: rollout plan idea: canary by customer tier + region, with automatic fallback to older model variant if latency/cost exceed thresholds. also quota guards to avoid noisy-neighbor overload.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled window opened for canary deploys next wed 09:00-11:00 UTC :gear:

elaine: prioritization ask — we have limited infra credits. vote on top-2 slices we should fund this quarter.

jordan: vote: slice A (embeddings) + slice B (streaming). embeddings revenue and churn impact are highest.

linda: vote: slice A + slice C. enterprise customers pushing rerank SLA.

devon: vote: slice B + slice A. streaming fix removes most customer complaints.

sarah: vote: slice C + slice A (quality first, but embeddings is big).

mike: note — if we pick A + B, we need an ops budget for extra instances; if A + C, can be more engineering work but less infra immediately.

elaine: consensus leans to embeddings (A) + streaming (B) but C becomes a near-term follow-up. action items:
- elaine -> draft OKRs & customer-facing docs by Fri (embed throughput targets, SLAs, rollout plan)
- devon -> prototype batching/quant strategy for embeddings by next Tues
- sarah -> assemble golden eval sets + quality checks by next Wed
- mike -> cost impact model + required reserved capacity pricing by Thurs
- linda -> confirm customer requirements + commercial ask from ACME/Helix by Thurs EOD

devon: ack, will push a basic perf bench and share numbers in #eng-runtime.

linda: i'll prep customer quotes and thresholds.

sarah: adding monitoring signals to the doc: p99 latency, median tokens/sec, embedding similarity drift, rerank precision@k.

elaine: perfect. we'll reconvene w/ drafts on Fri sync. thanks all :thumbsup:
